example_sentences_in_bangla: ত্রিযামার অন্ধকারে ভূতের গল্প শোনা যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: The city becomes silent in the triyama.
Ghost stories are heard in the darkness of triyama.
history: In traditional Hindu timekeeping, the night is divided into three yamas or watches, with triyama referring to the third and deepest part of the night.
note: This term originates from Sanskrit-influenced Bengali, used in classical literature to denote late night.
